This dataset includes links to policies, strategies and documents relevant to climate resilience on a wide range of geographic scales. The project was undertaken with the guidance of Leeds City Council and Leeds Climate Commission and contains a large amount of Leeds specific policies and data.

Please note

  • This dataset was created as part of a one off project and may not be updated.
